pad.title: A Legacy Forged in Gold
pad.body: Gold has been a cornerstone of Middle Eastern culture and economy for centuries — a symbol of wealth, power, and stability. Royal Orbit Gold embraces this heritage while setting new benchmarks for innovation and ethical standards in the modern gold market. From sourcing and refining to trading and investment, Royal Orbit Gold leads with integrity, transparency, and excellence.
pad.global_note: Headquartered in the Middle East, Royal Orbit Gold operates on a global scale, serving clients across continents.

protocols.name: PAD/POD context isolation
steps: Treat PAD as the portable content and behavior payload
Treat POD as the component that operates the PAD
Expose only section-local PAD data to the POD
Use public/private field metadata for propagation decisions
